Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.procedure

Class TestCreateTableProcedureDescriptorWriteFailure

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.procedure.TestCreateTableProcedureDescriptorWriteFailure
@Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MasterTests") @Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MediumTests") public class TestCreateTableProcedureDescriptorWriteFailure extends Object
Test for HBASE-30539: CreateTableProcedure must not move on to hbase:meta and region assignment when the table descriptor could not be written.

FSTableDescriptors.writeTableDescriptor retries 10 times. If every attempt fails it must throw, so that the create procedure stays in CREATE_TABLE_WRITE_FS_LAYOUT and retries, instead of publishing a table whose region servers can never load a descriptor ("Missing table descriptor for ...") and whose assign procedure retries forever.

    • testCreateTableDoesNotProceedWhenTableDescriptorWriteFails

      @Test public void testCreateTableDoesNotProceedWhenTableDescriptorWriteFails() throws Exception
      Every write of the table descriptor fails, so the 10 in-method attempts of writeTableDescriptor are exhausted, over and over. The create procedure must keep retrying CREATE_TABLE_WRITE_FS_LAYOUT: it must not fail, finish, add the regions to hbase:meta or start any TransitRegionStateProcedure for region assignment. Once the injection is cleared, i.e. HDFS recovers, the same procedure completes, the descriptor is on the file system and the region server can load it.
      Throws:
      Exception
